description: React component 'CredentialInputHandler' for managing credential input, including dropdown selection, dialogs for adding/editing credentials, and permission checks.

methods.name: editCredential
methods.description: Opens dialog to edit a credential by ID.

methods.name: addAsyncOption
methods.description: Fetches credential data and opens dialog to add new credential.

methods.name: onConfirmAsyncOption
methods.description: Handles confirmation of credential selection, updates state, and calls onSelect callback.

methods.name: onCredentialSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of a credential from list dialog.
